subject: Re: Payment structure and provisional retainage for pilot (Novamed)
messages:
From: Carolina Ruiz <carolina.ruiz@novamed.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Payment cadence and provisional retainage for pilot

Hi Connor / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency profile you demonstrated. Procurement and Finance ran a quick assessment and we have two ask items before we can issue a PO for the pilot: 1) Novamed requires Net60 payment terms for the pilot invoices, and 2) due to cross-border VAT uncertainty from our subsidiaries, Finance will hold a provisional retainage of 8% on each invoice until we can reconcile tax evidence (expected within 60–90 days).

Can Redwood accommodate Net60 for the pilot, and is there flexibility around the retainage being treated as a refundable hold rather than a credit reduction? If possible, please also provide a staging proposal that minimizes cashflow impact on Redwood (e.g., an upfront deposit or milestone payments). We can provide a short tax evidence list if helpful.

Attaching our standard procurement checklist for reference.

Best,
Carolina Ruiz
Director, Vendor Ops
Novamed

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment cadence and provisional retainage for pilot

Carolina / Matt — thanks for the clarity and for flagging the tax holdback. We can accommodate Net60 for the pilot but would like to propose a hybrid structure to balance both teams' cashflow and credit risk: 

- Pilot value: EUR 120,000 over 3 months (as scoped in attached SOW).
- Upfront deposit: 15% (EUR 18,000) due on PO signature to kick off provisioning.
- Monthly invoices: 2 invoices of EUR 34,400 (net of deposit) — due Net60.
- Final deliverable invoice: remaining balance; Novamed to hold an 8% provisional retainage on each invoice which will be tracked and released upon receipt of tax evidence.

Importantly, we can treat the 8% as a refundable hold in our accounting (we'll issue a separate credit memo once evidence is provided) rather than a forfeited discount. To reduce Redwood's short-term exposure, we can also offer an optional temporary credit facility up to EUR 50k (subject to simple KYC and a credit application) that would be deducted as a bridge against the retainage timing — effectively smoothing cashflow for Redwood for the first 60 days.

I've looped in Rishi (Finance) to confirm the mechanics and Laura (Legal) for contract language around the refundable hold. If that sounds workable, I'll produce a one-page payment schedule and a redline to the SOW that explicitly captures the hold/release steps.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Carolina — quick finance note from our side: 

- We can accept Net60 for the pilot provided the upfront deposit is cleared. The refundable hold mechanism is fine; we'll record a short-term liability labelled 'provisional retainage' and issue a credit memo within 10 business days of receiving tax evidence.
- To operationalize this, we need the following evidence from Novamed per EU VAT guidance: VAT registration copy for the billing entity, proof of cross-border VAT filings (last 2 quarters), and the purchase order referencing the billing VAT number. If Novamed can provide these within 60 days, the 8% will be fully refundable.
- If evidence is delayed beyond 90 days, we will escalate to our Credit Committee and propose either converting the hold to an offset against future invoices or agreeing a fixed short-term interest credit on the retained amount.

I'll work with Marcus in accounting to draft the credit memo template and the journal entries. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you prefer to run through the sequence.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Carolina Ruiz <carolina.ruiz@novamed.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com; rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Matt Ellis <m.ellis@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com

Connor / Rishi — appreciate the pragmatic proposal. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Upfront deposit: Novamed can approve a 10% deposit on signature (EUR 12,000) rather than 15% if Redwood can accelerate the first provision by one week.
2) Credit facility: Procurement prefers to avoid adding extra credit paperwork to the vendor file. If Redwood needs bridge funding, would you consider a one-time early invoice payment (discounted) instead of a formal credit line? We are open to a 1.5% early-payment fee applied to the portion we pay early.
3) Evidence timeline: we will commit to sending the VAT registration and Q3 filings within 45 days.

If we can confirm these three items, Procurement will issue a conditional PO and route it through eProcurement today. Please confirm and we can proceed.

Best,
Carolina
From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Carolina Ruiz <carolina.ruiz@novamed.com>; Matt Ellis <m.ellis@novamed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment cadence and provisional retainage for pilot

Carolina / Matt — sounds good and thanks for the flexibility. Confirming Redwood accepts the adjustments below: 

- Upfront deposit: 10% (EUR 12,000) due on conditional PO signature; we will provision the pilot environment within 7 business days of deposit receipt.
- Monthly invoices: two interim invoices and a final invoice per SOW, all Net60. Novamed will apply an 8% provisional retainage on each invoice.
- Early payment option: if Novamed chooses to pay any invoice early, Redwood will accept early payment on that invoice with a 1.5% fee (applied to the early-paid portion) in lieu of a formal credit facility.
- Evidence commitment: Novamed's team to deliver VAT registration and Q3 filings within 45 days; upon receipt Redwood will issue credit memos to release the provisional retainage within 10 business days.

Next steps: I'll produce a one-page payment schedule and a redline to the SOW reflecting the refundable hold + early-pay fee. Carolina — once you confirm the conditional PO has been submitted, we'll send the DocuSign package for the SOW and the one-page payment schedule.

Connor O'Brien
